name: BBQ Grill Portable, Charcoal Barbecue Grill Smoker Grill for Outdoor Cooking Camping Hiking Picnics
description:
Portable Charcoal BBQ Grill – Lightweight, Durable, and Ready for Outdoor Fun

Take your grilling game anywhere with this Portable Charcoal BBQ Grill, designed for convenience, durability, and outdoor cooking enjoyment. Perfect for picnics, camping, and backyard gatherings.

Key Features:

Lightweight & Portable: Easy to carry and set up, ideal for outdoor adventures.

Durable Metal Construction: High-quality painted metal with a stainless steel frame ensures long-lasting performance.

Free-Standing Design: Convenient setup without complicated installation.

Optimal Size: 14inch by 11 inch 
 – spacious enough for grilling a variety of foods while remaining compact for transport.

Fuel Type: Charcoal grill for authentic smoky flavor and traditional BBQ experience.

Specifications:

Colour: Black

Material: Metal

Frame Material: Stainless Steel

Finish Type: Painted

Installation Type: Free Standing

Included Components: BBQ Grill

Dimensions: 49.3 x 29.5 x 8.2 cm

Enjoy delicious BBQ anywhere with this Portable Charcoal Grill—lightweight, reliable, and perfect for every outdoor cooking enthusiast.
